entities.summary: Amy Andrea Childs is an English model and television personality. After appearing in the first two series of the ITV2 reality series The Only Way Is Essex, she starred in her own fly on the wall reality series It's All About Amy from 2011 to 2012. Childs then came in fourth place in the Channel 5 series Celebrity Big Brother 8 in 2011; in 2014, she participated in the Channel 4 series The Jump. Childs returned to The Only Way Is Essex in 2020.
